utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Eli — I heard the repair drive is picking up, which is great news. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — that’d be helpful. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll keep things on my usual schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, and if I hear anything about donations or volunteers, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I saw something about the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly just a hand if you’ve got one—help sorting the donations or loading things up would be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help for a bit—just tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the timing and who’s bringing what before we say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — please double-check and let me know. I’d rather confirm before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help however I can; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. We still need to sort the donated tools and make a quick list of what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools and jot down a missing-items list. Just point me to where the boxes are.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which repairs we’re prioritizing for the drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think the big ones were the broken fence panels and that leaky faucet at the community room. I’m pretty sure there was one more, but I’m blanking on it right now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the fence panels and the community room faucet. If the other repair comes to you, let me know so I can keep the list accurate.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m a bit late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries—it's still on track. We're gathering donations at the community center until 6, then sorting everything this evening.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—thanks. I’ll swing by the community center soon and see what still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus—happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam—could you help spread the word and see if anyone needs tools or spare parts? I can lend out what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can spread the word and check if anyone needs tools or spare parts. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive set up yet—do you know where they’re taking donations?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the school bulletin and let you know. If I find it, I’ll send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye—I'd appreciate that. I'll keep an eye out too in case I spot the donation location.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s still on, and folks around here are starting to chip in. If you’ve got anything to donate or know someone who can help, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors right away. If anyone has tools, time, or spare parts, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Quinn—thanks for helping spread it around. I’ll keep collecting names and donations, and I’ll let you know if we need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, how’s the repair drive going? Do you need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going alright, just a little slower than I expected. If you know anyone who can lend a hand with tools or pickup, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can ask around for tools and a pickup truck. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll tell folks about the repair drive and keep the plan going. Let me know the details, and I’ll repeat them around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll pass along the details as soon as I have them. Just keep me posted and I’ll relay anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and spread the word once you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving. Want to go over the list and see what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, we should probably check what’s already covered first. I can help look through the list with you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — let’s start with what’s already covered so we don’t duplicate anything. I’ll pull up the list, and we can mark off the items that are done.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam—folks seem to be dropping off tools and supplies already. If you need anything checked on, I can go ask around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. If you could ask whether they still need tape and a couple of screwdrivers, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know if they still need tape and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I was hoping you could help sort the donated parts and check what still needs fixing. If you’ve got time, we can start with the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can do that. I’ll start with the tool table and sort through the donated parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard all the details yet, but I’m happy to help if there’s something specific you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’m still figuring out what’s needed, but I appreciate you being willing to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—just let me know when you know what’s needed, and I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I just need you to pick the repair drive up from my place and make sure it gets dropped off at the community shop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I can swing by and drop it off at the community shop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—could you bring a box of gloves and some packing tape, and maybe help coordinate the drop-off list? I’d like to double-check the timing before we finalize anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I can bring gloves and packing tape, and I’ll help with the drop-off list. Just let me know the timing once you’ve double-checked it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I’d really appreciate that. We need a few tools, some volunteer hands, and help sorting the donated items.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can help sort the donated items and maybe round up a few neighbors too. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard folks are really pitching in for it. I’m headed out to run a few errands, but I can check on what’s still needed when I get back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira. That’d be a big help—just let me know what’s still needed when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll swing by and see what’s still needed, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo—what kind of repair help do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the cracked edge by the curb and the loose patch near the garage. If you can bring a shovel and some filler, I can show you exactly where.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that—I'll bring a shovel and some filler. Just point me to the spots when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and how we’ll get everything there. Can we sort out the schedule and transport first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—let’s lock down a pickup time and a vehicle first. What days and hours work best for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m free Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning. If we can get a car or van lined up, I can make either work.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—Cleo, you should definitely come by if you can!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll stop by if I can—thanks for letting me know. I’ll bring anything extra I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, thank you! Just swing by whenever you can—I’m sure the repair drive will appreciate anything you bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a big help—thank you. I was thinking late Saturday morning, maybe around 10?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 should work for me—I can check if that fits after the school run. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I’m putting together the repair drive details now. Do you want to help sort donations or spread the word on the block?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help spread the word on the block. Just tell me what to say and when to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be wonderful—please start today and tell folks we’re collecting repair supplies all week. I’ll send you a short message you can pass along.
